about: Skills by case. Each project turns cases on in .claude/skill-cases.local.json ({"on": ["ui-design", ...]}); the session-start hook lists the skills for the cases that are on. Load at most two skills per unit of work; design-time, motion and review-time sets stay apart. Community skills are read before first use. The kit owns this file; projects do not edit it.

cases.name: UI/UX design
cases.when: a screen, flow, component, form, error message or UI copy is being designed or built
cases.notes: Pick the one or two that fit the unit. A project's own visual style lives in that project's standards.

cases.name: Motion
cases.when: a transition or animation is added or changed
cases.notes: Each project sets its own motion limits; a restrained style is project-only.

cases.name: UI/UX review
cases.when: a built screen or flow is reviewed before a PR

cases.name: Building a feature
cases.when: new behaviour is planned and built

cases.name: Debugging
cases.when: a bug, a failing test or unexpected behaviour

cases.name: Review before a PR
cases.when: a branch is ready for its Pre-PR Deep Sweep

cases.name: Security-sensitive work
cases.when: auth, crypto, secrets, input handling or anything that sends data off the device

cases.name: ML and data work
cases.when: models, datasets, training, evals or data pipelines

cases.name: Cloudflare platform
cases.when: Workers, KV, R2, D1, Wrangler or other Cloudflare services

cases.name: Learning the decisions
cases.when: the owner wants a decision explained
